partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.

# UP DigiShakti Portal - Student Login, Registration & E-KYC

The Uttar Pradesh government has launched the UP DigiShakti Portal to facilitate the distribution of
tablets and smartphones to eligible students in the state. Through this portal, students can
complete their e-KYC verification, check their eligibility status, and access information about
tablet/smartphone distribution.

This portal streamlines the verification process through MeriPehchaan e-KYC and ensures eligible
students receive their devices efficiently.

[Student Login][6] [Status Check][7] [e-KYC Verification][8] [Tablet/Smartphone List][9]
💡
Important Notice: Only use the official website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/) to keep your
information secure. Do not share your Aadhaar details, enrollment number, or personal information on
any fake/malicious websites.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Student Login

To access the UP DigiShakti Portal for student verification and tablet/smartphone distribution,
follow this process:
1. First, visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at: [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][10]
2. Click on the "e-KYC through MeriPehchaan Portal" button on the website's homepage.
3. Select your University/Board/Society/Council and College/Institution from the dropdown menus.
4. Enter your enrollment number and the captcha code displayed on screen.
5. Click on the "Search" button to proceed.

Before proceeding with the verification, please ensure the following:
* Use only the official DigiShakti website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/)
* Have your enrollment number ready
* Ensure your Aadhaar details are correct and match with your educational records
* Have access to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP verification

## UP DigiShakti Portal e-KYC Verification Process

To complete the e-KYC verification on DigiShakti Portal using MeriPehchaan, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Access the DigiShakti Website

Visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][11]

[UP DigiShakti Portal Homepage]

### Step 2: Enter Student Details

Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter your enrollment number and
captcha, then click "Search" button.

[Student Details Entry]

### Step 3: Verify Student Information

Your details will be displayed on screen. If your Aadhaar e-KYC status shows "Pending", click on
"Verify through the Login using e-Pramaan MeriPehchaan" button.

[e-KYC Verification Button]

### Step 4: MeriPehchaan Sign-Up/Sign-In

You'll be redirected to the MeriPehchaan portal. If you're a new user, click on "New user? Sign up
for MeriPehchaan". If you're an existing user, sign in with your credentials.

[MeriPehchaan Login]

### Step 5: New User Registration (For new users only)

Enter your mobile number and verify it using OTP. Fill in your personal details exactly as they
appear on your Aadhaar card:

[MeriPehchaan Registration]
* Full name (as per Aadhaar)
* Date of birth (as per Aadhaar)
* Gender (as per Aadhaar)
* Create username and password
* Accept terms and conditions

### Step 6: Aadhaar e-KYC

Complete the Aadhaar e-KYC verification:

[Aadhaar e-KYC]
* Enter your Aadhaar number
* Choose OTP medium (mobile or email)
* Click on "verify through eKYC" button
* Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile/email
[Enter OTP]

### Step 7: Verification Complete

Upon successful verification, you'll see a success message and be redirected back to the DigiShakti
portal.

[Success Message]

### 🔎 Requirements for Verification:
* Aadhaar card with correct details (name, DOB, gender)
* Access to Aadhaar-linked mobile or email for OTP
* Enrollment number from your educational institution
* Your institution must have uploaded your correct details to the portal
* Your data must match between institutional records and Aadhaar

💡
Note: If your verification fails due to mismatches between your institution's records and Aadhaar
details, contact your Institution Nodal Officer to correct the information. After corrections,
you'll need to go through the verification process again.

3. Select your University/Board/Society/Council and College/Institution from the dropdown menus.
4. Enter your enrollment number and the captcha code displayed on screen.
5. Click on the "Search" button to proceed.

Before proceeding with the verification, please ensure the following:
* Use only the official DigiShakti website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/)
* Have your enrollment number ready
* Ensure your Aadhaar details are correct and match with your educational records
* Have access to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP verification

## UP DigiShakti Portal e-KYC Verification Process

To complete the e-KYC verification on DigiShakti Portal using MeriPehchaan, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Access the DigiShakti Website

Visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][11]

[UP DigiShakti Portal Homepage]

### Step 2: Enter Student Details

Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter your enrollment number and
captcha, then click "Search" button.

[Student Details Entry]

### Step 3: Verify Student Information

Your details will be displayed on screen. If your Aadhaar e-KYC status shows "Pending", click on
"Verify through the Login using e-Pramaan MeriPehchaan" button.

[e-KYC Verification Button]

### Step 4: MeriPehchaan Sign-Up/Sign-In

You'll be redirected to the MeriPehchaan portal. If you're a new user, click on "New user? Sign up
for MeriPehchaan". If you're an existing user, sign in with your credentials.

[MeriPehchaan Login]

### Step 5: New User Registration (For new users only)

Enter your mobile number and verify it using OTP. Fill in your personal details exactly as they
appear on your Aadhaar card:

[MeriPehchaan Registration]
* Full name (as per Aadhaar)
* Date of birth (as per Aadhaar)
* Gender (as per Aadhaar)
* Create username and password
* Accept terms and conditions

### Step 6: Aadhaar e-KYC

Complete the Aadhaar e-KYC verification:

[Aadhaar e-KYC]
* Enter your Aadhaar number
* Choose OTP medium (mobile or email)
* Click on "verify through eKYC" button
* Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile/email
[Enter OTP]

### Step 7: Verification Complete

Upon successful verification, you'll see a success message and be redirected back to the DigiShakti
portal.

[Success Message]

### 🔎 Requirements for Verification:
* Aadhaar card with correct details (name, DOB, gender)
* Access to Aadhaar-linked mobile or email for OTP
* Enrollment number from your educational institution
* Your institution must have uploaded your correct details to the portal
* Your data must match between institutional records and Aadhaar

💡
Note: If your verification fails due to mismatches between your institution's records and Aadhaar
details, contact your Institution Nodal Officer to correct the information. After corrections,
you'll need to go through the verification process again.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Status Check

To check the status of your application and e-KYC verification on the DigiShakti Portal, follow
these steps:
1. **Access the DigiShakti Portal**
   Visit the official website at https://digishakti.up.gov.in/
2. **Enter Your Details**
   Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter enrollment number and
   captcha.
3. **Check Your Status**
   Your verification status will be displayed on screen:
   * **Pending**: You need to complete e-KYC verification
   * **Verified**: Your e-KYC has been successfully verified
   * **Failed**: There's a mismatch between your institution data and Aadhaar data
   * **Under Process**: Your data is pending for Department Lock
4. **In Case of Failed Status**
   Contact your Institution Nodal Officer to edit the mismatched details on the portal, or update
   your Aadhaar information if needed.
5. **After Corrections**
   Your data will go through the authentication process again: verification by institution, approval
   by University, and locking by Department.
6. **Retry Verification**
   After corrections, your data will become available again for Aadhaar verification by you.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Tablet/Smartphone List

To check the tablet/smartphone distribution list and download relevant information:
1. **Visit the Official Website**
   Go to the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][12]
2. **Navigate to Distribution List**
   Look for the section related to tablet/smartphone distribution lists or beneficiary lists.
3. **Search Your Details**
   Enter your institution details, district, or other search parameters to filter the list.
4. **Download PDF List**
   Once you locate your relevant distribution list, you can download it in PDF format for future
   reference.
5. **Distribution Process**
   * After verification, your institution will notify you about the device collection process
   * You may need to bring your ID proof and enrollment details during collection
   * Distribution typically happens at your educational institution or designated centers

The UP DigiShakti Portal is an initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to distribute tablets and
smartphones to eligible students. The portal offers the following features and benefits:

* **e-KYC Verification:** Uses MeriPehchaan integration for secure Aadhaar-based verification

* **Educational Support:** Provides digital tools to enhance learning opportunities

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

high-technology sectors. Combined with the company's culture of responsiveness to the rapidly
changing needs of this dynamic industry this ensures that, in both content and delivery, Canalys
provides an exceptional service compared to other industry analyst firms.

what we want to be as a company. We hire and promote people based on their ability to demonstrate
them.

channels and smartphones. We provide vendors with subscription services and projects in Channels,

events in APAC, EMEA and LATAM. We have offices and team members in Europe, Asia, North and South
America.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

# UP DigiShakti Portal - Student Login, Registration & E-KYC

The Uttar Pradesh government has launched the UP DigiShakti Portal to facilitate the distribution of
tablets and smartphones to eligible students in the state. Through this portal, students can
complete their e-KYC verification, check their eligibility status, and access information about
tablet/smartphone distribution.

This portal streamlines the verification process through MeriPehchaan e-KYC and ensures eligible
students receive their devices efficiently.

[Student Login][6] [Status Check][7] [e-KYC Verification][8] [Tablet/Smartphone List][9]
💡
Important Notice: Only use the official website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/) to keep your
information secure. Do not share your Aadhaar details, enrollment number, or personal information on
any fake/malicious websites.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Student Login

To access the UP DigiShakti Portal for student verification and tablet/smartphone distribution,
follow this process:
1. First, visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at: [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][10]
2. Click on the "e-KYC through MeriPehchaan Portal" button on the website's homepage.
3. Select your University/Board/Society/Council and College/Institution from the dropdown menus.
4. Enter your enrollment number and the captcha code displayed on screen.
5. Click on the "Search" button to proceed.

Before proceeding with the verification, please ensure the following:
* Use only the official DigiShakti website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/)
* Have your enrollment number ready
* Ensure your Aadhaar details are correct and match with your educational records
* Have access to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP verification

## UP DigiShakti Portal e-KYC Verification Process

To complete the e-KYC verification on DigiShakti Portal using MeriPehchaan, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Access the DigiShakti Website

Visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][11]

[UP DigiShakti Portal Homepage]

### Step 2: Enter Student Details

Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter your enrollment number and
captcha, then click "Search" button.

[Student Details Entry]

### Step 3: Verify Student Information

Your details will be displayed on screen. If your Aadhaar e-KYC status shows "Pending", click on
"Verify through the Login using e-Pramaan MeriPehchaan" button.

[e-KYC Verification Button]

### Step 4: MeriPehchaan Sign-Up/Sign-In

You'll be redirected to the MeriPehchaan portal. If you're a new user, click on "New user? Sign up
for MeriPehchaan". If you're an existing user, sign in with your credentials.

[MeriPehchaan Login]

### Step 5: New User Registration (For new users only)

Enter your mobile number and verify it using OTP. Fill in your personal details exactly as they
appear on your Aadhaar card:

[MeriPehchaan Registration]
* Full name (as per Aadhaar)
* Date of birth (as per Aadhaar)
* Gender (as per Aadhaar)
* Create username and password
* Accept terms and conditions

### Step 6: Aadhaar e-KYC

Complete the Aadhaar e-KYC verification:

[Aadhaar e-KYC]
* Enter your Aadhaar number
* Choose OTP medium (mobile or email)
* Click on "verify through eKYC" button
* Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile/email
[Enter OTP]

### Step 7: Verification Complete

Upon successful verification, you'll see a success message and be redirected back to the DigiShakti
portal.

[Success Message]

### 🔎 Requirements for Verification:
* Aadhaar card with correct details (name, DOB, gender)
* Access to Aadhaar-linked mobile or email for OTP
* Enrollment number from your educational institution
* Your institution must have uploaded your correct details to the portal
* Your data must match between institutional records and Aadhaar

💡
Note: If your verification fails due to mismatches between your institution's records and Aadhaar
details, contact your Institution Nodal Officer to correct the information. After corrections,
you'll need to go through the verification process again.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Status Check

To check the status of your application and e-KYC verification on the DigiShakti Portal, follow
these steps:

   * **Verified**: Your e-KYC has been successfully verified
   * **Failed**: There's a mismatch between your institution data and Aadhaar data
   * **Under Process**: Your data is pending for Department Lock

   * **Pending**: You need to complete e-KYC verification
   * **Verified**: Your e-KYC has been successfully verified
   * **Failed**: There's a mismatch between your institution data and Aadhaar data
   * **Under Process**: Your data is pending for Department Lock
4. **In Case of Failed Status**
   Contact your Institution Nodal Officer to edit the mismatched details on the portal, or update
   your Aadhaar information if needed.
5. **After Corrections**
   Your data will go through the authentication process again: verification by institution, approval
   by University, and locking by Department.
6. **Retry Verification**
   After corrections, your data will become available again for Aadhaar verification by you.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Tablet/Smartphone List

To check the tablet/smartphone distribution list and download relevant information:
1. **Visit the Official Website**
   Go to the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][12]
2. **Navigate to Distribution List**
   Look for the section related to tablet/smartphone distribution lists or beneficiary lists.
3. **Search Your Details**
   Enter your institution details, district, or other search parameters to filter the list.
4. **Download PDF List**
   Once you locate your relevant distribution list, you can download it in PDF format for future
   reference.
5. **Distribution Process**
   * After verification, your institution will notify you about the device collection process
   * You may need to bring your ID proof and enrollment details during collection
   * Distribution typically happens at your educational institution or designated centers

## Why InstaCash?

##### [Simple and Hassle-Free Experience][45]

Selling your old smartphone has never been this easy. With InstaCash, complete the deal in just
three steps: Get an algorithmically generated price quote, schedule a convenient pickup, and receive
instant payment. No more haggling at local shops or getting bombarded with messages on classified
platforms. Experience the best re-commerce website with zero hassles.

##### [Best Price Estimate - Instantly!][46]

Unlock the highest value for your old smartphone. Our advanced InstaCash Smartphone Price Algorithm
(ISPA) instantly provides a competitive price based on your phone's brand, specifications, age, and
condition. Whether it's Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, or OnePlus, get a price that surpasses
your expectations without any negotiations.

##### [Convenient Home Pickup][47]

Once you decide to sell, just let us know your preferred pickup location, date, and time. Our
dedicated team ensures a seamless experience right up to your doorstep, culminating in a secure
financial transaction.

##### [Complete Ownership Transfer - Your Data is Safe][48]

Trust in our commitment to your privacy. When you sell with InstaCash, our representative ensures
that all your data is wiped clean, adhering to industry standards. Your old smartphone is processed
securely, ensuring no misuse of device or data.

##### [Instant Payment - Secure and Transparent][49]

Experience the joy of instant digital payments. Whether you prefer a bank transfer or Paytm, receive
your money even before handing over the phone. We prioritize your privacy, ensuring all financial
details remain confidential.

##### [Pan India Presence - We're Everywhere][50]

InstaCash proudly offers pickup services in over 1800 towns across India. Even if you're in a remote
location, our team strives to reach you. Your convenience is our mission.

##### [Global Presence - Trusted by Thousands][51]

Join our growing family of satisfied customers not just in India, but also in Malaysia, Singapore,
Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand. Discover the InstaCash difference and get the best buyback
offers for your old smartphone.

## About Us

SM Distribution is a tier 1 world-wide distributor of high-quality electronics and smartphones. We
have earned a reputation for quick and efficient turnaround, outstanding customer service,
impeccable attention to detail, favorable wholesale pricing, and honest straightforward business.

We service the global market of wholesale and retail establishments, brick and mortar chain
stores/department stores, local distribution partners, schools, the hospitality industry as well as
the corporate gift market.

We offer a broad variety of the most popular models of mobility products, including: mobile phones,
tablets, laptops, portable audio devices, headphones, speakers, video gaming consoles, cameras, and
other consumer electronics. We carry quality products from the most respected brand name
manufacturers ranging from most commonly purchased to high-end.

Our enormous volume allows us to offer favorable pricing, with added value to loyal and high-volume
customers. Additionally, because we enjoy excellent relationships with key industry players and
manufacturers, we are able to offer excellent price points that other distributors are unable to
offer.

position to provide rapid and efficient delivery to North America, South America, Europe, the Middle
East, and Asian markets.

At SM Distribution, customer service is our hallmark. We forge relationships with each customer,
whether large or small, and we work with you to identify and fulfill your specific goals; our
knowledgeable customer service representatives are available and responsive to your needs. Because
we have our finger on the pulse of the international markets, we can offer clients intelligent and

## About Us

SM Distribution is a tier 1 world-wide distributor of high-quality electronics and smartphones. We
have earned a reputation for quick and efficient turnaround, outstanding customer service,
impeccable attention to detail, favorable wholesale pricing, and honest straightforward business.

We service the global market of wholesale and retail establishments, brick and mortar chain
stores/department stores, local distribution partners, schools, the hospitality industry as well as
the corporate gift market.

We offer a broad variety of the most popular models of mobility products, including: mobile phones,
tablets, laptops, portable audio devices, headphones, speakers, video gaming consoles, cameras, and
other consumer electronics. We carry quality products from the most respected brand name
manufacturers ranging from most commonly purchased to high-end.

Our enormous volume allows us to offer favorable pricing, with added value to loyal and high-volume
customers. Additionally, because we enjoy excellent relationships with key industry players and
manufacturers, we are able to offer excellent price points that other distributors are unable to
offer.

With multiple locations and portside shipping points plus a huge inventory, we are in a unique
position to provide rapid and efficient delivery to North America, South America, Europe, the Middle
East, and Asian markets.

At SM Distribution, customer service is our hallmark. We forge relationships with each customer,
whether large or small, and we work with you to identify and fulfill your specific goals; our
knowledgeable customer service representatives are available and responsive to your needs. Because
we have our finger on the pulse of the international markets, we can offer clients intelligent and
incisive advice and guidance, as well as knowledgeable forecasting and market consulting.

[Products & Solutions][106]

The SOTI ONE Platform makes mobile-first business operations simple, efficient and reliable.

SOTI MobiControl makes mobility management easy. It simplifies the security and management of
multi-vendor, multi-form factor and multi-operating system devices.

SOTI Snap enables organizations to rapidly create mobile apps that digitize business processes and
boost worker productivity.

SOTI XSight has the support and management tools needed to fix mobile device problems faster and
analytics-based insights to help you make smarter, data-driven decisions.

SOTI Connect is an enterprise management solution that provides an organization complete lifecycle
management of its mobile and industrial printers.

SOTI Identity enables simple and secure access to the SOTI ONE Platform suite of solutions.

SOTI Pulse is an online community for SOTI partners and customers to collaborate with product
experts and solution providers.

Linux Management

Windows Management

SOTI Stella

Established in 1998, Canalys is world-renowned for its research in technology channels and
smartphones. Canalys now spans four continents with five offices and employs over 100 people.

Learn more

The team at Canalys bring with them many years of experience as advisors to the IT and
high-technology sectors. Combined with the company's culture of responsiveness to the rapidly
changing needs of this dynamic industry this ensures that, in both content and delivery, Canalys
provides an exceptional service compared to other industry analyst firms.

Learn more

We believe that the following values, skills and behavior are vital to what makes us Canalys and
therefore help achieve our strategy. Canalys’ values are partly about who we are, but also about
what we want to be as a company. We hire and promote people based on their ability to demonstrate
them.

Learn more

Canalys was set up in 1998. We have grown to become world renowned for our research in technology
channels and smartphones. We provide vendors with subscription services and projects in Channels,
Enterprise and Emerging Tech and Mobility. We also host the best and largest independent channels
events in APAC, EMEA and LATAM. We have offices and team members in Europe, Asia, North and South
America.

Learn more

Analysis of the channel is at the heart of our business. We have services to help the world’s
largest tech companies manage their partner landscape.

Creatons is an electronics manufacturing solution provider, based in Delhi NCR, India, specializing
in custom electronic devices and accessories. Our dedication towards R&D and continual advancement
in terms of latest technologies, has made us a renowned name in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing Services (EMS).

### Products & Services

Creatons offers its customers 360-degree services.

If you are looking for solutions to all your requirements in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing, then we are a complete package to your needs. We provide end-to-end services starting
from procurement, design and manufacturing to multi-level quality checks to deliver to notch
products. We also offer PCB Assembly Services for varous products.

Creatons is built on high level “integrity” – it is the foundation of what we do. Our defining
characters have been team work & accountability, leading our manufacturing relationships to a great
success.

Creatons believes in continuous learning. We share valuable inputs, gained through experience and
skill, to our clients to ensure that they get the best possible solution to their requirements.

**Transparency**

Our managing team allows for clear communication with our clients and vendors to avoid anything that
might get lost in translation. Being transparent always paves off to build trust among businesses.

**Support**

Creatons offers unparalleled services to always support our clients in every way possible. The team
doesn’t shy away from going the extra mile to make our customers happy.

**Punctuality**

We are located in Delhi NCR, India, the capital of the world’s fastest growing economy. Timely
deliveries, without compromising on quality has been one of our strong points.

**Quality**

Quality control is an integral part of every step of our production plan. We continuously analyse
and makes improvements to our QC procedures to ensure grade-A deliveries always.

become a complete one-stop solution for all your buying needs. Daraz prides itself on not being just
another ecommerce venture in Asia. We work tirelessly to make sure that we provide users with the
best online online shopping experience and value for their purchases. Whether you shop online
through our website or our online shopping mobile App, you can expect easy navigation, customized
recommendations, and a smooth online shopping experience guaranteed.



### What Makes Us Different from Other Online Shopping Platforms?

**Select from the Largest Online Marketplace in Pakistan**

listing of products in the country. Whether you’re looking for electronics, apparel, appliances, or
groceries – there is something for everyone.

**Hassle Free Delivery **
Online shopping is only as good as its execution and Daraz promises hassle free delivery right from
the moment you order to when your package is dropped at your door. We cater to both major and
smaller cities alike, and give you the choice to track your package as it makes its way to you so
you always know your order status. If you are unsatisfied with any aspect of your order, we have a
simple 7-day return or exchange policy.

**Payment Options to Suit Every Style **
You can choose to pay through a credit/debit card, opt for cash on delivery or even go for EMI (easy
monthly instalments). You can also avail exclusive offers by downloading Daraz Wallet – a closed
loop digital wallet that offers you a secure, easy way to make payments. We also have easypaisa &
jazzcash payment method for our customers' ease

**Shop from Verified Vendors **
Daraz understands that online shopping in Pakistan comes with its fair share of risks. This is why
with Daraz Marketplace and Daraz Mall customers have the security of choosing from verified vendors
and brands from Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and all across Pakistan. Now you’ll never have to second
guess authenticity because Daraz makes sure to do it for you!




**Shop Around the World with Daraz Global Collection **
International sellers and local convenience come together with Daraz Global collection. Get the
chance to shop online from vendors around the world without leaving the Daraz website. Featuring
thousands of novelty gadgets and accessories, Daraz Global Collection offers you a selection of
products that you won’t find anywhere else when you’re online shopping in Pakistan.

**Avail Exclusive Discounts, Offers, and Promotions **
Online shopping with Daraz means you get the chance to avail exclusive online-only promotional
packages as well as discount vouchers from our vendors when you shop from their pages. Our flash
sales give you customized product offers all curated with the help of our advanced AI technology so
you always have deals you’ll actually be interested in!

**Buy Value, not Just Goods with Daraz Care **
Daraz does not just cater online shopping in Pakistan but also aims to simplify the way you give
back to society. With charities spanning across sectors of education, health care, environmental
preservation, and shelters, you can choose to make a big difference with a few, simple clicks.

Who says corporate purchases need to be a complicated affair? When you opt for Daraz Corporate, you
get an efficient and transparent solution for your business’ bulk purchasing needs. We’re proud to
be working with some of the most prestigious organizations in Pakistan across a number of different

## About Us

SM Distribution is a tier 1 world-wide distributor of high-quality electronics and smartphones. We
have earned a reputation for quick and efficient turnaround, outstanding customer service,
impeccable attention to detail, favorable wholesale pricing, and honest straightforward business.

We service the global market of wholesale and retail establishments, brick and mortar chain
stores/department stores, local distribution partners, schools, the hospitality industry as well as
the corporate gift market.

We offer a broad variety of the most popular models of mobility products, including: mobile phones,
tablets, laptops, portable audio devices, headphones, speakers, video gaming consoles, cameras, and
other consumer electronics. We carry quality products from the most respected brand name
manufacturers ranging from most commonly purchased to high-end.

Our enormous volume allows us to offer favorable pricing, with added value to loyal and high-volume
customers. Additionally, because we enjoy excellent relationships with key industry players and
manufacturers, we are able to offer excellent price points that other distributors are unable to
offer.

With multiple locations and portside shipping points plus a huge inventory, we are in a unique
position to provide rapid and efficient delivery to North America, South America, Europe, the Middle
East, and Asian markets.

At SM Distribution, customer service is our hallmark. We forge relationships with each customer,
whether large or small, and we work with you to identify and fulfill your specific goals; our
knowledgeable customer service representatives are available and responsive to your needs. Because
we have our finger on the pulse of the international markets, we can offer clients intelligent and
incisive advice and guidance, as well as knowledgeable forecasting and market consulting.

The SOTI ONE Platform makes mobile-first business operations simple, efficient and reliable.
